name: Job Security
overview: Scripture reveals that true job security rests not in human effort or worldly circumstances but in the sovereign care and providence of the Lord. The Psalms affirm that the steps of a righteous person are established by God, who delights in guiding their way, and His protection ensures that harm will not come near them even amid widespread adversity. Jeremiah assures believers that God’s plans are for their peace and hopeful future, while Ezekiel portrays the Lord as a shepherd who actively seeks and delivers His scattered sheep. Jesus further teaches that anxiety over material needs is misplaced, emphasizing the greater value of life beyond food and clothing, underscoring that security ultimately comes from trusting God’s provision.
